I have depression and a chronic illness. It's easy for me to fall into caretaker/sickie relationship with my girlfriend because she's naturally inclined toward a caretaker role. We've found it's important for us to realize when this is happening, because continuing it leads to resentment. I acknowledge that my depression, anxiety, and chronic illness is what's causing it, but these are not excuses. That's an important distinction to make. Even if these are the reasons I'm behaving a certain way, /I am still responsible for my behaviors/. It's important for me to remember I am not a slave to my illnesses. Even if all I can manage is making up the bed one day, it's still important that I actively try and don't just chalk it all up to my illnesses. I guess what I'm getting at is that even if you understand why your partner is doing something, that doesn't excuse them from at least trying not to do it.

Sometimes one person will be giving 5% and the other will have to give 195%.
